unit: One previously adopted instruction in an official HWPX attachment. Paragraph numbers refer to saved UTF-8 extraction, without decorative headings.
scope: All document text retained in both arms. Add the same literal heading landmarks from old business fields to each edition. An editorial question sheet opens the existing two-file Folio review workflow; it is not an official source. Adopt from the OLD edition before sync. Eligibility for sampling: an identifiable operational field in the original notice. Selection is purposive; both editions had been inspected, so this is not a blind holdout.
arms: Unified diff of all extracted paragraphs; a strong baseline maps changed old paragraph ranges to the same saved decision lines.
Actual Folio store, one sentence per topic. Reopen only if its selected evidence changes. Capture exact before/after and source versions.
metrics: changed-field detection, false reopens among unchanged decisions
amount of raw changed material versus named decisions to inspect, in different units
presence of prior decision owner, rationale and both version pointers without manually joining records; no human timings
